S1: The canonical candidate itself says the matching FastWAM-Joint checkpoint is unconfirmed; the allowed inputs do not identify exact checkpoint revisions or instantiate either baseline configuration. The conditional Motus/RoboTwin fallback cannot stand in for FastWAM-Joint. — no claim depends on it

S2: No measured profile, verified joint-model entry point, hardware target, or exact original latency-gate value is present in the permitted inputs, so neither headroom nor the stop decision can be instantiated. — no claim depends on it

S4: The mask rule is specified, but no held-out episodes, gate values, or measured full-path latencies are available; therefore the epsilon-selection criterion cannot be applied. — a claim depends on this step

S5: Neither target backend's compact variable-length/block-sparse implementation or joint entry-point integration is verified in the allowed inputs. A dense mask alone would not establish skipped work or latency improvement. — a claim depends on this step

S6: The canonical candidate supplies the omitted exact-cost boundary-token rule, but no paired evaluation, task-success result, full-path latency, or legal source-group permutation is established by these inputs. The requested comparison is a planned empirical test, not an observed result. — a claim depends on this step

S7: The candidate and intake say the matching AgileX policy/checkpoint, demonstrations/data, source implementation, and local same-type hardware are unconfirmed; no simulation gate was run. — no claim depends on it
